blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Public Works and Highways Undersecretary Roberto Benardo’s former aide on Wednesday testified that he delivered several “boxes” to Sen. Jinggoy Estrada four times from 2024 to 2025. These trips reportedly ended up at a building in San Juan City. Francisco dela Fuente, Bernardo’s former driver, disclosed these information as he testified
